mapper.sql: id, file_title, file_name, original_name, file_type, file_size, media_type, mime_type, width, height, duration_ms, status, public_path, create_by, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_tenant_website_asset ( id, file_title, file_name, original_name, file_type, file_size, media_type, mime_type, width, height, duration_ms, status, public_path, create_by, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{fileTitle}, #{fileName}, #{originalName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{mediaType}, #{mimeType}, #{width}, #{height}, #{durationMs}, #{status}, #{publicPath}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_tenant_website_asset WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND status = 'active'

SELECT FROM crm_tenant_website_asset
AND status = 'active'
AND media_type = #{mediaType}
AND file_title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{fileTitle}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_tenant_website_asset SET status = 'deleted', update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND status = 'active'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM crm_tenant_website_page WHERE draft_schema::text LIKE CONCAT('%', '/_assets/', #{assetId}, '%') OR published_schema::text LIKE CONCAT('%', '/_assets/', #{assetId}, '%')
